app_name: Restaurant management app (working name until the friend's handoff arrives)
what_it_does: A management app for the restaurant manager and the staff: shift scheduling, swaps and a time clock with hours for payroll; tasks and checklists (opening, closing, cleaning, food safety, training); stock counts and supplier orders. More features exist; details will come from the friend's handoff.
who_it_is_for: Restaurants, cafés, bars and bakeries with roughly 8+ employees on shifts, where the owner or general manager runs shifts, hours, tips and stock on WhatsApp, Excel or paper.
good_signs: Hiring right now (job posts on Facebook, Instagram, AllJobs or a 'דרושים' sign): staff turnover is the pain
Busy: many reviews, a large sit-down area, a bar, or a big team visible in photos
Long opening hours or open 7 days, so many shifts to cover
Waiters or bartenders (tips to split and top up to minimum wage)
Two or more branches, or events and catering on top of the restaurant
Heavy daily stock or production (bakery, kitchen with many fresh items)
bad_signs: Part of a national chain or franchise (systems decided at HQ)
Clearly already using a management system (mentions Restigo, MarketMan or similar)
Possibly closed, temporary or seasonal pop-up
pitch_he: אפליקציית ניהול למסעדה: סידור עבודה ושעון נוכחות, משימות וצ'קליסטים, מלאי והזמנות מספקים, במקום אחד למנהל ולעובדים.
price_note: First-year estimates per restaurant type are in lead_agent/data/app_types.json (setup + 12 months). Never put prices in openers.
